Stocklana main track - tokenized stocks on Solana

The ticker is familiar.
The token is mysterious.

RWA Sonar reads the legal documents and the Solana chain behind every tokenized stock and answers what the holder owns, who holds the keys, how to get out and what changed, with a source for each answer.

Public build refreshes every 6h Stocklana: 25 Sep 2026, 4:00pm ET Crypto World's Fair: 12 Oct 2026

01

The product answer

Ask what happens if it breaks.

Failure scenarios answered for each issuer from its own documents, marked documented, inferred, litigated or unknown. Beside them, who holds each on-chain power.

Keys stolen
xStocks: nothing comes back as of right.

Documented. The only replacement route is a Swiss court cancellation the issuer itself calls "very challenging to achieve".

Keys stolen
Superstate: the transfer agent "can reconstitute" tokens.

Documented. Burned and reissued once the loss and your identity are confirmed. Not promised, and liability is capped.

Keys held
12 programmes × 7 powers.

21 cells held by one key, 15 by a multisig, 10 by a program, 12 not installed, 26 unknown. xStocks' power to move or burn holder tokens: a 2-of-3 multisig with no time lock, not used on Solana through 18 Sep 2026.

02

Monitoring

It re-reads every source on a schedule.

HourlyKeys and extensions

Every catalogued mint's authorities, extensions, rebase multiplier and supply, with the slot as evidence.

DailyEvery cited document

Re-read, diffed, quotes re-checked word for word. If a page cannot be read, we use the publisher's API or a Wayback capture.

DailyRedemptions on chain

Ondo burns, xStocks de-activations, Superstate conversions. A day not read is missing, never zero.

DailyModel assessment

A model reads each changed document. Its verdict is shown next to the diff and never decides what is shown. The legal review date moves only when an analyst records a review.

Observed on Solana - 19 Sep 2026

PreStocks transfer fee 0.50%Transfer fee 1.00%

All eight mints changed from 50 bps to 100 bps at fee epoch 1039; evidence is the programme authority account observed at Solana slot 448348634.
Flows and float - 23 Sep 2026

218 Ondo redemptions, 370 creations

In the 17.9 hours the scan read. Redeemed xStocks return to issuer wallets. On 24 Sep 2026 those wallets held 81.0% of priced xStocks supply, including an inventory wallet the issuer excludes from its circulating figure.

03

Why Solana, and what is new here

What Solana reveals about each token

Token-2022 puts the issuer's powers in the mint account. RWA Sonar reads them for every exact address and sets them beside what the documents promise. RWA.xyz and DefiLlama measure the size of the market. RWA Sonar does L2BEAT-style trust analysis and extends it past the contract to custody and law.

01

Identity

Exact Token-2022 mint joined to issuer registries and reviewed sources.

Issuer attribution is separate from market coverage
02

Controls

Mint, freeze, pause, clawback, allowlist, transfer fee and rebasing, traced to the key or multisig that holds each.

Holding a power does not mean the issuer may use it
03

Docs vs chain

Loopscale's docs call a key a co-signer that "cannot initiate actions on its own"; on chain it signs refinances alone.

Discrepancies keep both sides cited
04

DeFi proof

Protocol listing, account existence, decoded configuration and simulation are separate states.

Actual lending requires its own evidence beyond a registry listing
